cd /c/Dot; git add bridge/server.js package.json .github/workflows/ci.yml && git commit -q -m "fix: keep idle connections open longer than fetch does (\"fetch failed\" on Node 20); per-test limit 5 min

Node's fetch keeps an idle connection for 4 s; the bridge closed its end at 5 s,
so on Node 20 a reused connection could be closing under a request. The
bridge now keeps idle connections for 65 s. The 60 s per-test limit also
applied to whole test files on Node 20, so it's 5 minutes.

ts reusing a port an earlier test had used,** so `fetch` grabbed that test's dead connection. Fixed: each test file never reuses a port.

I also added limits so a hung test can never block CI for hours again: 5 minutes per test, 15 per job.
